calls.statement:
SELECT fs.week_ending_date, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (fs.store_key, fs.product_key)) AS dk, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores, count(DISTINCT p.sku) AS skus, sum(fs.closing_value) AS val, min(fs.etl_loaded_at) AS mn, max(fs.etl_loaded_at) AS mx
FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-28' AND DATE '2026-08-09' AND cp.category='Paint & Decorating' AND s.store_id<900
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT fs.week_ending_date, p.category AS cat_asat, cp.category AS cat_current, count(*) n, sum(fs.closing_value) val,
 sum(fs.closing_units*cp.standard_unit_cost) AS val_cur_cost, sum(fs.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost) AS val_ver_cost,
 sum(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, sum(CASE WHEN fs.closing_value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nullv,
 count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores
FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-05' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND s.store_id<900 AND (cp.category LIKE 'Paint%' OR p.category LIKE 'Paint%')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

calls.statement:
WITH weekly AS (
    SELECT fs.week_ending_date, SUM(fs.closing_value) AS closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fs.week_ending_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 'Paint & Decorating' AS category,
       ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS average_closing_stock_value_at_cost, COUNT(*) AS weeks
FROM weekly
